name: Plugin folder
description: Files in the plugin's own folder on disk for the organization (orgs/<organization>/plugins/<plugin>/), the folder a [[watch]] listens to. Paths are relative to that folder; a plugin can never reach anything outside it.

capabilities.name: Read
capabilities.description: Read a file or look at its size and date. Maps to kernel commands fs::read and fs::stat.

capabilities.name: List
capabilities.description: List the files in a folder. Maps to kernel command fs::list.

capabilities.name: Write
capabilities.description: Create or replace a file, or move one inside the folder. Maps to kernel commands fs::write and fs::rename.

capabilities.name: Delete
capabilities.description: Delete a file or an empty folder. Maps to kernel command fs::delete.
